title: Arbitrarily Loss-Tolerant Quantum Position Verification in a Single Execution
summary: Quantum position verification (QPV) aims to certify the location of an untrusted prover, but faces two major obstacles: fundamentally, entanglement-based attacks and, experimentally, photon loss. A commitment-based modification introduced in Phys. Rev. Lett. 135, 260801 addresses both in sequentially repeated protocols. Its security analysis, however, relies on the sequential structure and does not extend to parallel repetition. We use a different proof approach to establish security of the commitment modification for a parallel BB84-based QPV protocol. Against bounded-entanglement…
